title.narrative: Program to Support Transparency and Integrity Reforms in Argentina II
Programa de Apoyo a Reformas de Transparencia e Integridad en Argentina II

description.narrative: El objetivo del programa es contribuir a la transparencia e integridad de la gestin pblica mediante regulaciones y mecanismos que promuevan el acceso a la informacin. En esta segunda operacin, se profundiza el abordaje de las siguientes materias: (i) la regulacin de la legislacin de acceso a la informacin pblica y la consolidacin de regmenes de conducta tica de los funcionarios pblicos; (ii) la consolidacin de las regulaciones y mecanismos para la gestin de los recursos del Estado Nacional en lo referido a las contrataciones de obra pblica y compras pblicas, y al empleo pblico; y (iii) la gestin del sector financiero. La presente operacin es la segunda de dos consecutivas, vinculadas tcnicamente entre s, pero financiadas de forma independiente, bajo la modalidad de Prstamo Programtico de Apoyo a Reformas de Poltica (PBP).

The objective of the program is to contribute to the transparency and integrity of public management through regulations and mechanisms to promote access to information. This second operation will deepen progress in the following areas: (i) regulation of the legislation on access to public information and consolidation of the rules for ethical conduct of public officials; (ii) consolidation of the regulations and mechanisms for management of State resources in relation to public works contracting, public procurement, and public sector employment; and (iii) management of the financial sector. This is the second of two consecutive operations that are linked technically but financed independently under the programmatic policy-based loan (PBP) modality.
